ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) pixel baseline across approximately 85% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) linear and point-source disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity mass forming the primary lobe structure. High-intensity white linear streaks are mapped medially and laterally on both lobes. High-intensity circular clusters are concentrated at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped central depression with a wide pixel angle and low vertical depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (peaks and valleys) along the entire span, with increased amplitude noted on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep transitioning to convex curvature near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters representing circular surface disruptions, concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear scarring across the main fluke surface and jagged irregularities/encrustations visible at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The image exhibits a binary-like high-contrast thresholding that highlights edge topography and surface markings against a saturated white background.
